document.title: Agent tooling: Pages deploy wait, check:changed, worktree setup
document.summary: The Pages publish script waits for its deploy and reruns a failed one once; a new script checks changed files; worktree setup works without T3; AGENTS.md points agents to the right files and commands.
document.why: A retro of 10 agent sessions found agents losing time on Pages 404s after publish, worktrees without node_modules or .env, hand-built vp check file lists, and AGENTS.md pointers that led to wrong files or commands.

groups.title: Pages publish waits for its deploy
groups.why: A second publish within a minute or two made the pages-build-deployment run fail with 'in progress deployment', and agents polled a 404 by hand.
groups.summary: After the push, publish polls the Actions run whose head SHA is the pushed gh-pages commit, reruns it once on failure, and the skill tells the agent what each deploy state means.

attention.note: `publish` now exits 1 when the deploy does not succeed, although the gh-pages push did. The URL prints before the wait, so callers keep it. Decide if a non-zero exit is the right signal for a pushed but undeployed site.

fileNotes.scripts/pages-review.ts: Adds `waitForPagesDeploy`, the zod-parsed run response, `--no-wait`, and returns the pushed commit from publish.
fileNotes.scripts/pages-review.test.ts: Drives the wait with a fake `gh` and clock: success, one rerun, failed rerun, missing run, timeout.
fileNotes..agents/skills/pages/SKILL.md: Replaces the 'Pages is off' 404 line with deploy states, the background pages/builds retry, and one publish per PR with screenshots in the folder.

groups.title: pnpm check:changed
groups.why: Agents built vp check file lists by hand; zsh does not word-split them, and a markdown-only list fails with 'No files found to lint'.
groups.summary: The new package script runs vp check with --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern on files changed since the merge-base with origin/main plus untracked files.

fileNotes.scripts/check-changed.ts: Collects the file list in Node, drops deleted paths, and passes extra flags such as --fix through.

groups.title: Worktree setup without T3
groups.why: Delegate worktrees came up without node_modules and .env, and the setup script refused to run without T3CODE_PROJECT_ROOT.
groups.summary: `mainCheckout` reads the first `git worktree list` entry, and the script uses it as the project root when the env var is unset.

attention.note: The script body now runs under `if (import.meta.main)` so the test can import `mainCheckout`. `import.meta.main` exists from Node 24.2; `engines` says `>=24`, so on 24.0 or 24.1 the script would do nothing.

fileNotes.scripts/setup-worktree.ts: Exports `mainCheckout` and guards the install and env-link steps behind `import.meta.main`.
fileNotes.scripts/setup-worktree.test.ts: Builds a repo with a linked worktree and checks both resolve to the main checkout.
fileNotes.CONTRIBUTING.md: Says how the script picks the root and that it runs by hand in any worktree.

groups.title: AGENTS.md pointers
groups.why: Agents found field sites through typecheck errors, used a stale global skill, skipped `pnpm sync:skill`, and rebuilt the screenshot harness by hand.
groups.summary: Each edited line points at the command or file the retro found agents missing: setup-worktree, check:changed, ui:screenshots, src/api, src/review files, the field grep, generate:schema, sync:skill, the local-CLI PR flow, and --cli-login.

commits.subject: Agent tooling: Pages publish waits for its deploy, check:changed, worktree setup
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
- pages-review publish waits for the pages-build-deployment run of the pushed gh-pages commit, reruns it once on failure, and prints the deploy state (--no-wait skips)
- pnpm check:changed runs vp check on files changed against origin/main, markdown included
- setup-worktree defaults the project root to the main checkout
- AGENTS.md: pointers for screenshots, src/api, new review fields, skill sync, PR review flow, --cli-login

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
